title: Engineering Manager
announcement: About Eucalyptus We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.   Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.   Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times. Our Growth Story: Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada. About the Role As an Engineering Manager, you will lead an engineering team to ensure fast, high-quality execution. You will focus on rapid experimentation and technical excellence across the full customer lifecycle - from awareness and acquisition through to retention, revenue, and referral. Operating at the intersection of engineering, product, and growth marketing, you will partner with cross-functional stakeholders to translate strategic visions into scalable engineering solutions. You will be responsible for empowering your team, optimising execution velocity, and maintaining high engineering standards as we scale our preventative care ecosystem globally. Key Responsibilities Ensure High-Quality Execution: Manage an engineering team or function to drive fast, reliable software delivery. Resolve Technical & Operational Blockers: Act as an escalation point for complex technical and operational issues, solving them efficiently to keep projects on track. Optimise Workloads: Balance priorities and take active responsibility for optimising team workload to maintain predictable delivery without burnout. Drive Growth & Experimentation: Own the execution of sophisticated, data-driven experiments and growth initiatives across the entire patient journey. Improve Engineering Processes: Continuously refine development processes, workflows, and team structures to build a high-velocity environment. Build & Mentor Talent: Partner with talent acquisition teams to recruit, onboard, and retain world-class engineers while fostering a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and high morale. Align Cross-Functionally : Partner seamlessly with Product, Marketing, and Data stakeholders to align technical delivery with commercial goals. About You Technical Strength & Codebase Ownership: You are technically strong and partner credibly with senior engineers-able to evaluate system architecture and spot when technical estimates lack substance. Coding is not the primary job, but you are comfortable getting on the tools in an ecosystem built on React, React Native, TypeScript, Go microservices, GraphQL, Kubernetes, and GCP, and delivering work to unblock your team. Leadership Experience: Proven track record managing an engineering team to ensure fast and high-quality execution. Operational Focus: Demonstrated capability in solving escalated issues, optimising team workloads, and driving continuous improvements across team workflows and structures. Experimentation & Growth Mindset: Hands-on background or strong familiarity with rapid experimentation, A/B testing, and building software optimised for user engagement, conversion, and retention. People-First Leadership: Skilled at mentoring engineers, navigating shifting priorities, and nurturing an inclusive, highly motivated team culture. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with a history of bridging technical delivery with product strategy, growth marketing, and commercial outcomes. Nice to Have Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them. Why join Eucalyptus What's next  - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies. Build something world-changing  - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding. Make real impact  - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets. Accelerate your growth  - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support. Join a motivated team  - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale. What's ahead in the UK Be an owner  - Your own stake in the business with our employee options programme Invest in your growth  - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave Work flexibly  - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration Support your well-being  - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you Take time off  - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year Join a connected team  - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process.
